name: HARNLEN
recent: Harn Len 近期持续进行股份回购，并有多名董事及大股东申报持股变动。公司也披露了一项重大诉讼，同时发布了季度业绩，营收同比增长但净利大幅下滑。
notable: 公司于2026年10月26日发布截至2026年8月31日止季度的业绩。
公司于2026年10月29日公告一项重大诉讼。
公司于2026年10月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
risks: 公司于2026年10月29日公告一项重大诉讼。
多名董事及大股东于2026年10月7日申报持股变动。
earnings: 截至2026年8月31日止季度，营收为93,081,233令吉，环比增长31.4%，同比增长31.3%；净利为2,531,172令吉，环比下降45.0%，同比下降88.7%，净利率为2.7%，低于上一季度的6.5%。

recent_en: Harn Len has been actively buying back shares and has seen multiple director and substantial shareholder interest disclosures. The company also disclosed a material litigation and released quarterly results with higher revenue but a sharp drop in net profit.
notable_en: The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026 on 26 October 2026.
The company announced a material litigation on 29 October 2026.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 29 October 2026.
Several directors and substantial shareholders disclosed changes in their interests on 7 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was MYR93,081,233, up 31.4% QoQ and 31.3% YoY; net income was MYR2,531,172, down 45.0% QoQ and 88.7% YoY, with a net margin of 2.7% versus 6.5% in the previous quarter.
